preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(S) <= 1000 for S in substrings)
preconditions.description: Each substring S has a length between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '01' for c in S) for S in substrings)
preconditions.description: Each substring S contains only characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, int) for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= num_classes <= 1000000 for num_classes in output)
postconditions.description: Each output integer represents the number of equivalence classes, which is between 1 and 1000000.
